shots.title: Find the fox
shots.action: Open already brushing. A real late pass reveals an eye or muzzle.

shots.title: Make the change
shots.action: Two useful passes, with a clear cut forward to later progress on this Fox.

shots.note: Same partial-clean reference for composition; the edited progression is still to be filmed.

shots.title: Finish the last patch
shots.action: Final effective movement, then the actual 1.8-second suction and 99% polish.
shots.motion: Record from before completion. Let the engine finish naturally.
